crossRefs.note: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God…
and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever.…
I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them…

parallels.note: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever.…

translations.kjv: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
